title: 第1章 西门庆与飞刀
slug: 满级小李飞刀我在水浒当判官
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

大宋政和四年三月，阳谷县县狱，午夜。

西门庆躺在湿冷的稻草上，觉得自己大概是活不成了。

往日里他西门庆也算阳谷县的知名人物，家里药铺，典当，绸缎诸多生意连绵。

多年经营之下，整个县治上下俱都收过他好处，历任阳谷知县，都予西门庆几分薄面。

但自打年初新知县上任，西门大官人的日子立时便窘迫起来。

这新知县姓李，单名一个逸字，乃是去年癸巳科新举的探花，据说琼林宴上一篇《北疆十策》让官家都连连点头，更被太师蔡京招为孙女婿。

如此人物外放到阳谷做知县，西门庆本以为自己交了天大的好运，若是攀交的好，日后对方飞黄腾达，自己也能跟着鸡犬升天。

怎料这李逸刚一到任，便似盯上了他，一个月不到，就把西门庆往日贿赂官员、强占田产等诸多不法之事查了个底掉，之后更以此为契机，把县衙里那些与西门庆沆瀣的胥吏，尽皆撤换。

从始至终，西门大官人都没想明白自己是如何得罪了那李逸，以至被他如此针对。

此刻西门庆已被关入监牢，只待最终论罪。

“西门庆，跪下，知县大人到了！”

狱卒的呵斥之声将西门庆的遐思拉回，他扭头一看，却发现不知何时，李逸已站在栏杆之外，正饶有兴致的看着自己。

李逸看上去二十出头，身形高瘦，顾盼间，丝丝俊秀从容流转，可称一表人才。

难怪会被蔡京一眼看上、招为孙女婿了。

“罪民见过知县大人。”

西门庆扑通一声跪倒，磕头如同捣蒜。

李逸深夜到此，必有缘由。

难不成自己的案子，尚有转机？

“把裤子脱了！”

李逸看着西门庆，古怪一笑，脸上写满期待。

西门庆愣住了。

大半夜的，怎么张口便让自己脱裤子？

莫非他……？

“大人，这—”

西门庆话音未落，只听“啪”一声，一旁的狱卒早一巴掌狠狠抽在他脸上。

“叫你脱裤，聋了么？”

感受着脸上火辣辣的疼，西门庆再不敢拖延，他老老实实褪下裤子，站定在李逸面前。

李逸眼前一亮！

《水浒》所言不虚，这西门庆当真养的好大龟！

潘驴邓小闲，这一个驴字他倒当之无愧。

“嗯，名不虚传！”

知县大人点了点头，他示意西门庆站起，接着转身便欲离去。

Page (1/3)

In March of the fourth year of Zhenghe's reign in the Song Dynasty, it was midnight in Yanggu County Prison.

Ximen Qing lay on the wet and cold straw, feeling that he might not survive.

In the past, Ximen Qing was also considered a well-known figure in Yanggu County. His family had a lot of business including drug store, pawn shop, and silk.

After many years of management, the entire county government has received benefits from him, and every successive Yanggu magistrate has treated Ximen Qing somewhat lightly.

However, since the new magistrate of the county took office at the beginning of the year, the life of the high-ranking officials in Ximen immediately became difficult.

This new county magistrate's surname is Li, with the word "Yi" in his name. He was the top pick in the Guisi Science Examination last year. It is said that the "Ten Strategies for Northern Xinjiang" written at the Qionglin Banquet made officials nod their heads, and he was even recruited as his grandson-in-law by Grand Master Cai Jing.

When such a person was sent to Yanggu to serve as a county magistrate, Ximen Qing originally thought that he had great luck. If he made good friends with him, he would become famous in the future, and he would be able to follow him to heaven.

Unexpectedly, Li Yigang seemed to have set his sights on him as soon as he took office. Within a month, he investigated Ximen Qing's past bribery of officials, seizure of land and many other illegal things. Later, he took this as an opportunity to replace all the subordinate officials in the county government who were collaborating with Ximen Qinghang.

From the beginning to the end, Ximen officials never understood how they had offended Li Yi and were so targeted by him.

At this moment, Ximen Qing has been imprisoned, awaiting final trial.

"Ximen Qing, kneel down, the magistrate is here!"

The jailer's scolding brought Ximen Qing back from his reverie. He turned around and found that Li Yi was standing outside the railing at some point, looking at him with interest.

Li Yi looks to be in his early twenties, tall and thin, and looks handsome and calm. He can be called a talented person.

No wonder Cai Jing took a fancy to him and recruited him as his grandson-in-law.

"The guilty people have met the magistrate."

Ximen Qing fell to his knees with a plop, kowtowing like pounding garlic.

There must be a reason why Li Yi came here late at night.

Is it possible that there is still hope for my case?

"Take off your pants!"

Li Yi looked at Ximen Qing and smiled strangely, his face full of expectation.

Ximen Qing was stunned.

How could you open your mouth and ask yourself to take off your pants in the middle of the night?

Could it be that he...?

"Sir, this-"

Before Ximen Qing could finish his words, he heard a "pop" sound, and the jailer on the side slapped him hard on the face.

"Are you deaf when I ask you to take off your pants?"

Feeling the burning pain on his face, Ximen Qing didn't dare to delay any longer. He took off his pants and stood in front of Li Yi.

Li Yi's eyes lit up!

What "Water Margin" said is true, this Ximen Qing really raised a big turtle!

Pan Donkey, Deng Xiaoxian, he deserves the word donkey.

"Well, it's well-deserved!"

The magistrate nodded, signaled Ximen Qing to stand up, then turned around and left.
